Passed with `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/enactic__openarm_maniskill_simulation --backend fake` (evidence contract_checked). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware was attached, no hardware/sim backend was run and no hardware run is claimed. The clone robots/enactic/openarm_maniskill_simulation stayed unmodified at 3d3615aadabff11ce61ddc2e1608c1447cb3a59d (G1 passed).

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card says family-config/GymnasiumDriver, but the clone is an overlay of four files copied into a ManiSkill v3.0.0b21 checkout (README.md:41-56); PickCubeEnv inherits ManiSkill's BaseEnv, which is not in the clone. An AST read of the class therefore shows neither action_space nor observation_space, and those names occur nowhere in the clone; a Gymnasium-family fake that supplies them (the bridge requires them) would fail G7.NOT_UPSTREAM. This package is instead a direct Driver over the environment object (the same shape as the LIBERO package), serving cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. The action is the OpenArm end-effector delta (3 numbers, -0.1 to 0.1 m, openarm.py:100-109) plus the gripper joint position (0 to 0.0451 m, openarm.py:183-190); one tick is one environment step. The real ManiSkill action space depends on the control mode chosen by the external BaseEnv, which the clone does not state, so the driver publishes that controller-config action and the fidelity gaps say the arm and its controller are not modelled.

Coverage: PickCube-v1 only. PullCube-v1 and PushCube-v1 (README.md:64-68) are not covered. The upstream SAPIEN/ManiSkill environment was never opened (its SAPIEN, torch, numpy and ManiSkill dependencies are absent where the gate ran) and nothing here was compared with it; the fake backend is the package's pure Python analytic stand-in (fake.py). NOT COVERED: the full ManiSkill state observation (robot qpos/qvel), the 128 x 128 base_camera and 512 x 512 render_camera images, rendering, the openarm URDF, the seven-joint arm and its PD controller, contacts/friction/mass, and the 50-step control timestep (the clone states none, so fidelity.timestep_ms is 0). The fake's grasp test is a distance test, not OpenArm.is_grasping's contact-force test (openarm.py:255-286), and its robot is always static because it has no joint velocities.

Expected warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call, as for every Gymnasium-family seed action); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset, step and close because PickCubeEnv's BaseEnv is not in the clone while all three names occur in the clone's text. G4 reported no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. The two limits cite lines that show them (openarm.py:100-109 and :183-190); no limit is operator_required, and only catalogue classes are bound, so there are no catalogue requests. License recon: the clone has no LICENSE file and the card's NOASSERTION/unknown is correct; publish_review is required and this package must not be published before the owner's licence decision, but that is not a build blocker. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
